title: Deprecate tkinter.filedialog.askopenfiles()
author: serhiy-storchaka
body_preview: # Feature or enhancement  `tkinter.filedialog.askopenfiles()` returns a list of already-open file objects, which is inherently unsafe:  * If opening one of the files fails, the files already opened are leaked — there is no way to build the result without this risk. * A list of open files cannot be used in a `with` statement.
